correctness.rationale: The exact finite law follows by multiplying truncated occupancy exponential generating functions and marking a bin already at its capacity at the next arrival. Independent rate-1/N Poisson processes for each bin give Gamma(2,N) and Gamma(3,N) first-rejection clocks. At scale N^(2/3), class-one survival log -> -alpha*x^2/2 and class-two -> -x^3/6 whenever a_N/N^(2/3)->alpha; differentiation yields the claimed marked densities. When a_N is much larger, N/sqrt(a_N) instead yields Rayleigh law and negligible class-two risk; when smaller, pure cubic-Weibull. Independent exponential waiting times and the maximal martingale inequality justify de-Poissonizing the time without changing the failing-bin mark. Coupling independent Exp variables gives strictly increasing class-one win probability and unique alpha*≈0.5521857197206905. The Poissonized fixed-alpha O(N^-1/3) log-survival is not misrepresented as a discrete clock error. Independent exact occupancy recursion agrees with all coefficients for N<=5.
